project.name: Namu AI Workbench
project.productType: Local Windows installer and diagnostic dashboard

motion.policy: short physical press feedback; respect reduced motion

must: Preserve setup IDs, option names, consent and local API protection
Make all functions usable by keyboard and at narrow widths
Render actual engine results; clearly label simulations

decisions.decision: User requested hyperrealistic skeuomorphism: a tactile instrument console with coherent lighting, brushed metal, recessed displays and physical switches.
Match the GitHub repository and local dashboard with a futuristic midnight-blue, electric-cyan and violet identity while preserving tactile hardware controls.

evidence.query: skeuomorphic instrument panel tactile metal switches
evidence.use: Visual direction only. Existing native components are retained; no third-party component code retrieved or copied.

evidence.query: futuristic midnight cyan violet developer console
evidence.use: Visual reference leads only; original CSS and SVG retain native project components without dependencies.
